spans.s: Gṛhāṇāṁ pravibhāgaḥ: : Name of the 85th parvan in the list of a hundred subparvans of the Bhārata supposed to have been made by Vyāsa in the Parvasaṁgraha (pravibhāgo gṛhāṇāṁ ca)

.

Apparently this refers to the assigning of the houses, after the war, of Duryodhana, Duḥśāsana, Durmarṣana and Durmukha to Bhīma Arjuna, Nakula and Sahadeva respectively 12. 44. 6-13. [Yuyutsu, Vidura, Saṁjaya, Sudharman (Duryodhana's Purohita cf. Nī. on Bom.

: sudharmāṇam duryodhanapurohitam) and Dhaumya retained their old houses 12. 44. 14].
